snippet.title: À La Mine - Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
À la Mine – Demo Now Available on Steam

The official demo of À la Mine is here! Play as ambitious dwarves battling for control of the kingdom’s richest mine in this chaotic turn-based strategy game for 3 to 6 players.

Outbid, conquer, and sabotage your rivals to become the mine’s true owner. Every match is full of twists, alliances, and surprises.

Try the free demo now on Steam!
